en: Saraṇaduka, Āsavagocchaka (The Pair on Refuges, Chapter on Taints)

Dependent on a state that is neither a canker (*āsava*) nor a fetter (*saṃyojana*) … (Abbreviated. Five [conditions] in the case of root; two in the case of object … pe … one in the case of result … pe … five in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a fetter nor a canker … Dependent on a state that is neither a fetter nor a canker …

Dependent on a state that is neither a canker (*āsava*) nor associated with a canker (*na-āsava-sampayutta*) … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition (*hetu*), five; under object-condition (*ārammaṇa*), two … pe … under resultant-condition (*vipāka*), one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition (*avigata*), five.

Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor dissociated from a canker (*na-āsava-vippayutta*) … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition, three; under object-condition, one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition, three.
Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor dissociated from a canker … [End of section].

Dependent on a state that is neither a canker (*āsava*) nor associated with a canker (*na-āsava*), and neither a flood (*ogha*) nor associated with a flood (*na-ogha*)... (Abbreviated. Five in the case of root-cause (*hetu*); two in the case of object (*ārammaṇa*) ... pe ... one in the case of result (*vipāka*) ... pe ... five in the case of non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and not a canker itself (*na-āsava*) ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and dissociated from a canker (*āsavavippayutta*) ... pe ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and not dissociated from a canker (*na-āsavavippayutta*) ... pe ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and not a canker itself ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and dissociated from a canker ... pe ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and not dissociated from a canker ... pe ... Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor associated with a canker, and not a canker itself ... [and so forth].
Dependent on a state that is neither subject to cankers (*na-āsava*) nor dissociated from cankers (*na-āsava-vippayutta*), which is not subject to cankers (*na-āsava*) ...

Dependent on a state that is neither subject to cankers nor dissociated from cankers, which is not non-subject-to-cankers (*na-anāsava*) ... (Abbreviated. Under the root condition (*hetu*), there are three; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), one ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), there are three.
